articleTitle: CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) Implementation in High-Speed Semiconductor Memory
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: This paper presents a CRC scheme for the semiconductor memory devices. Conventional error detecting method by using the ATM-8 HEC code leads to a considerable burden on the timing margin at the time of reading and writing of the low power memory devices for CRC(Cyclic Redundancy Check) calculations. The proposed error detecting scheme is improved area-overhead up to 92% and decreased 2 stage of XOR. The error detection coverage has improved compared with conventional method.

articleTitle: Development of Low-Carbon Electricity System Based on Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: In the 21st century, electricity supply will face more and more challenges, trends of low-carbon economy and energy conservation work requirements for safe and reliable operation of power systems and green economic development put forward new and higher requirements. With the increasing complexity of the power system and power system operating environment continues to advance, the traditional power network needs to further improve and achieve the transition to a smart grid. Supporting role in the new era of smart grid of low-carbon electricity system, with the role of energy conservation and clean development, research proposed based on clean production, reduce losses, and optimize end-saving investments can be able to low-carbon electricity system construction and development to provide the necessary support, it has very important significance.

articleTitle: A Random Network Model with High Clustering Coefficient and Variation in Node Degree
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: The Erdos-Renyi model-based random network graphs are characteristic of having a low clustering coefficient (a measure of the probability for a link to exist between any two neighbors of a node) and low variation in node degrees, and hence do not match closely to graphs abstracting real-world networks. Our hypothesis is that the clustering coefficient of the nodes could increase if preference is given to closing as many triangles as possible during link formation. Accordingly, when node u is looking for a new link to be setup with some other node x, we consider x along with the two-hop neighbors of u and choose one among these nodes with a probability plink as the new neighbor of node u. The proposed Two-Hop Neighbor Preference (THNP)-based model generates random graphs whose clustering coefficient decreases with increase in node degree, but still exhibits a Poisson-style distribution for node degree and path length.

articleTitle: A Study about Adjacent Baggage Recognition to Control the Adjoined Bags in Airport
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: The number of baggage with increasing passengers through the airport has been an explosive increase. For fast and reliable handing of baggage, the importance of Baggage Handling System has gradually increased. The checked-in baggage is top-loaded from conveyor belt into high speed tray for quick processing of it. Before top-loading, the baggage may be unstably positioned, dropped, or double loaded on the tray by various situations. Baggage Position Control System in an airport controls the position of baggage just before top-loading to solve the problems such as unstably positioned baggage or double loaded baggage. In this paper, we discuss the method that distinguishes whether the baggage is adjacent to the other or not in order to process adjacent or unstable baggage in the control part of Baggage Position Control System.

articleTitle: Research on Power Transformer Relay Protection and Operation Processing
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: Power transformer is more important original power system, it has the failure of small, reliable structural features, but in the actual operation of the process, or will have some failures and anomalies. Therefore, in order to reduce the impact caused by a fault on the power system to protect the safe operation of the power system must be based on the situation of power substation capacity rating, voltage protection devices installed higher reliability. In normal operation of the power transformer as the starting point, describing the various types of interference generated by common faults of power transformers, power transformers analyzes the basic principles of configuration protection, and in the power protection features Transformers forth the premise of providing electricity Related measures and methods do transformer protection, to ensure stable power transformers and protective devices, safe operation played systematic and technical assurance.

articleTitle: Efficient Tree Indexing for PCM-Based Memory Systems
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improvement over the B+-tree for phase change memory (PCM). Particularly, we consider the read/write tendency of leaf nodes. For write-intensive leaf nodes, we use an overflow-node technique to reduce PCM writes, while for read-intensive leaf nodes, we adjust the tree structure to remove overflow nodes to improve read performance. Our experimental results suggest that our proposal is efficient for PCM.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Reactive Power Compensation Based on Low Voltage Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: With our country's economic development, people continuously raise the living standard, electricity as a kind of clean and renewable energy has becomes indispensable in people'sdaily life and work. But facing the huge power supply, power grid construction in China hasbeen difficult to meet the needs of the people and the wastage of the network also isincreasingly prominent. Reactive power compensation device can effectively reduce networklosses, at the same time it can also provide the strong guarantee to the safe operation ofpower grid. In order to meet the need of the present low voltage power grid, the reactivepower compensation system is necessary. This paper analyzes the distribution networkreactive power compensation, the related modules, principle and its application pattern oflow voltage power grid reactive power compensation.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity and High Performance SISO Decoding for Block Product Turbo Code (105,44)
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: Benjamin's low complexiry sof input soft output (SISO) decoding algorithm is simple in the configuration and but shows less significant bit error rate (BER) performance in an additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN). To solve this problem, we propose a new algorithm which is based on the syndrome check with an alpha value into the decoder to enhance BER performance. We also confirm the performance of the proposed method using the block product turbo code (105,44).

articleTitle: Design and Development of Power Communication Resource Management System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: Power line communication necessary, should match the best ways to control. In this paper, the goal of building built on top of GIS electricity cable communication network resource management systems, analysis of the overall structure of the system. The system supports C/Sand B/S two access modes. Details of the functional modules of the system structure, key technology research system development. Introduction of component technology system design, fully consider the diversity of GIS development platform, supporting multiple GIS development tools, has good openness and scalability. Build a transport network resource management platform to achieve optimized network organization and transmission systems, the use of physical and logical resources integrated management of the transmission network and the resources for the construction of electric power communication network, management, maintenance, fault detection, information inquiry service.

articleTitle: A Novel Dynamic Surface Control Based on State Observer
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: The traditional surface control method is developed in this paper which is based on the state observer on line and this method is applied in saturated water-steam temperature system. Certain first-order low-pass filters are introduced into the designing process to avoid the occurrence of high-order derivatives of elements in the system which makes it easy to implement in practical applications. The stabilization of this control method is verified. Simulation results show that the dynamic surface control method still ensures an accurate result, even if the loads change in a great and parameters of the controlled plant change significantly.

articleTitle: Output Tracking Problem of Uncertain Nonlinear Systems with High-Order Nonlinearities
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: This study addresses the problem of global practical output tracking by state feedback for a class of high-order non-linear systems with more general uncertainties, to which the existing control methods are inapplicable. By introducing sign function and necessarily modifying the method of adding a power integrator, a continuous state feedback controller is successfully constructed to guarantee the tracking error achieve arbitrarily small.

articleTitle: Approximated Error Performance of MQAM Burst Transmission for Relay Systems over Rayleigh Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: In this paper, we derive the averaged bit and symbol error probabilities as approximated closed-forms for M-ary quadrature amplitude modulation (MQAM) burst transmission of adaptive decode-and-forward (ADF) relay systems over quasi-static Rayleigh fading channels. Within a burst, there are pilot symbols and data symbols. Pilot symbols are used for channel estimation schemes and each relay node's transmission mode selection schemes. The approximated error rate expression is verified based on the number of relays, pilot, and data symbols. Its accuracy is confirmed by comparing with simulation results.

articleTitle: A Universal Concurrent Framework for Fault Diagnosis in Processor Based Systems
publicationTitle: 2015 8th International Conference on Control and Automation (CA)
abstract: After acceptance of artificial intelligence paradigm, a number of successful artificial intelligence systems were created. The most successful area of artificial intelligence is knowledge based systems (KBS). In industries there are many successful applications of KBS. One of the unattempted application is fault diagnosis in processor based systems. The paper discusses implementation of an intelligent frame work using concurrent object orient approach. The knowledge representation is done using software design patterns. The Inference is achieved by using message passing. The paper demonstrates fault diagnosis in typical processor based systems using UML diagrams and also discusses performance over traditional approaches.
